sub-flow.name: sf-validate-stock-request
sub-flow.doc:description: Validates an order event sent to a stock reservation endpoint: orderId, status and a non-empty items array are required.

when.expression: #[(not (payload is Object)) or isEmpty(payload.orderId) or isEmpty(payload.status) or (not (payload.items is Array)) or isEmpty(payload.items)]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Missing order fields
raise-error.description: orderId, status and a non-empty items array are required

sub-flow.name: sf-reserve-stock-for-order
sub-flow.doc:description: Simulated warehouse reservation for every item of the order in the payload; records the reservation in the ledger and leaves the order as payload.

os:store.doc:name: Record Reservation
os:store.os:value: #[output application/java --- { orderId: payload.orderId, reservationId: vars.vReservationId, orderStatus: payload.status, items: payload.items map { sku: $.sku, quantity: $.quantity }, reservedAt: now() as String }]

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log reservation
logger.message: #['Stock reserved for orderId=' ++ payload.orderId ++ ' (status ' ++ payload.status ++ '), reservationId=' ++ vars.vReservationId ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

flow.name: stock-get-reservations
flow.doc:description: GET /eip/stock/{orderId}/reservations: how many stock reservations were made for an order, and for which order statuses.
